verses.1: But the spirit says that in certain times, some people abandon their faith. They are deceived by spirits and teachings of demons.
verses.2: In the defense of the falsehoods of those who are deceived by their own self-awareness.
verses.3: To be covered with filth, to avoid the impurities that God has appointed for those who are faithful after their death, and to be able to reveal the truth.
verses.4: For all creation by God is good, and nothing is wasted, having received blessings in return.
verses.5: For it is honored through the word of God and as a test.
verses.6: Believing that this would be a good minister for the brothers, Jesus chose him as his deputy. He was trained in the teachings of faith and righteousness.
verses.7: But he abandoned those false and misleading myths. He also practiced humility in his actions.
verses.8: For physical exercise is useful only to a limited extent. But self-discipline is useful in every situation, as it embodies the essence of life, both now and in the future.
verses.9: The argument is valid and worthy of acceptance in all cases.
verses.10: For in this way, we will be honored and praised, since we have ascended to the God who lives. He is the Savior of all people, especially those who are faithful.
verses.11: He also praised these things and taught about them.
verses.12: Do not despise your youthfulness. Instead, become a model of faith in your words, in your actions, in your love, in your trustworthiness, and in your purity.
verses.13: Until then, I will continue to pay attention to the reading, the instructions, and the teachings.
verses.14: Do not despise the gift that was given to you through prophecy, along with the signs from the elders.
verses.15: Consider these things carefully, and let them be clear to you. This will help you understand the situation better.
verses.16: He kept himself and his teachings under control. He waited for them. By doing this, he could save himself as well as those who listened to him.
